_comment: Assertions that FAIL TO EXECUTE on the DuckDB engine, with the cause and the fix.
AssertionCorpusDigestTest refuses an error that is not listed here, and refuses an
entry that no longer errors - so a fix cannot land without this file shrinking, and
a new error cannot land at all.
EMPTY, and meant to stay that way. The three entries this file was created for were
all fixed in the publisher on 2026-09-07 (see duck/publisher-fixes.patch):
mapGroup = '' on a SMALLINT column, twice - MySQL coerces the literal to 0,
DuckDB refuses the cast per row, so both assertions errored on any release with
complexmap rows and the AU nightly has none. Now rewritten to = 0 at publish time.
a statement ending '... ) commit', because its script omits the semicolon before
its final 'commit;'. The publisher now strips a trailing transaction-control
token and says so; the upstream fix is the missing semicolon.
An entry here is a defect being carried, not a decision. It needs the error, the
cause, what MySQL does instead, and the fix - so the next person can finish it.
